scope: Full ATS/JRS LAM guideline text posted by the American Thoracic Society, including the sirolimus, VEGF-D, doxycycline, and hormonal-therapy recommendations.

keyRecommendations.text: For LAM with abnormal or declining lung function, recommend sirolimus rather than observation (strong, moderate-quality evidence).
For selected patients with problematic chylous effusions, suggest sirolimus before invasive management.
Suggest not using doxycycline and not using hormonal therapy. When CT is characteristic but other confirmatory features are absent, recommend VEGF-D testing before lung biopsy.

clinicalBottomLine: Use sirolimus for LAM with falling lung function, and consider it before an invasive procedure for a chylous effusion. Do not use doxycycline or hormonal therapy. Use a VEGF-D test to confirm the diagnosis before biopsy when the CT looks like LAM and there is no other confirmatory feature.
notableCaveats: Replaces the abstract-only PMC record. The society PDF is the full guideline.
